booking_request_received.name: Booking Request Received (to visitor)
booking_request_received.description: Acknowledge a public booking request the moment it's submitted
booking_request_received.subject: We got your booking request — [DATE] at [TIME]
booking_request_received.content:
Hi [NAME],

Thanks for booking with [ORG]. We've received your request for [TREATMENT] on [DATE] at [TIME] and will confirm by email shortly.

If anything's wrong, just reply to this email.

— [ORG]

booking_request_admin_alert.name: New Booking Request (to staff)
booking_request_admin_alert.description: Notify your admins the moment a public booking request comes in
booking_request_admin_alert.subject: New booking request — [VISITOR_NAME] · [TREATMENT] · [DATE] [TIME]
booking_request_admin_alert.content:
A new public booking request just arrived.

Visitor: [VISITOR_NAME]
Email: [VISITOR_EMAIL]
Phone: [VISITOR_PHONE]
Treatment: [TREATMENT]
Requested: [DATE] at [TIME]
Notes: [VISITOR_NOTES]

Approve or decline in the Booking Requests panel.

booking_request_declined.name: Booking Declined (to visitor)
booking_request_declined.description: Send a polite decline message when staff rejects a public booking
booking_request_declined.subject: About your booking request for [DATE] at [TIME]
booking_request_declined.content:
Hi [NAME],

Unfortunately we're unable to confirm your [TREATMENT] booking on [DATE] at [TIME].

[REASON]

Please pick another time on our booking page — we'd love to see you.

— [ORG]
